subject: Finalize reserve matrix & evaluation agenda
content:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@calyxsys.com>, procurement@calyxsys.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Finalize reserve matrix & evaluation agenda

Hi Evan / Calyx team,

Thanks for the productive demo last week — excited by the product direction. Attached are two working drafts: a reserve_matrix (spreadsheet) and a proposed MAP agenda. The goal of this thread is to lock the capacity target and evaluation milestones so procurement and my ops team can align on lead times.

Quick summary / asks:
- Target commit window: ideally a 2027-01-31 start for dedicated capacity (customer-side cutover schedule).
- Requested GPU pool sizing (proposal A): 24 H100-equivalent GPUs (expected to cover peak LLM inference for initial prod). Alternate option B: 96 A100-v2 equiv. Let us know which is more aligned to your performance SLA.
- Lead time question: we estimate a 10-week lead time to provision Dedicated pools in us-west for that configuration. Please confirm your internal procurement window and any constraints on PO timing.
- Acceptance & eval plan: 
  * Week 0–2: private staging access, run 3 canonical prompts + perf baseline.
  * Week 3–4: throughput ramp, run customer traffic replay for 48h.
  * Week 5: acceptance signoff (latency & error budget) or remediation plan.

Attachments: reserve_matrix_v1.xlsx, MAP_agenda_v2.pdf

Next step: Can we schedule a 30-min alignment call the week of Dec 14 to confirm the GPU mix and a hard PO target? Proposed times: Tue 12/15 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 12/16 15:00–15:30 PT.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@calyxsys.com>

Cc: procurement@calyxsys.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Finalize reserve matrix & evaluation agenda

Ben — thanks for the clear plan and the files. A couple quick notes from procurement and infra:

- Procurement team needs a confirmed lead time in writing for the exact SKU mix (H100 vs A100). Can you confirm 10 weeks for 24 H100s or provide an official provisioning SLA?
- On acceptance: we may need SOC2 evidence before granting staging access. I'll attach our checklist (calyx_requirements.docx).
- Cost ask: please include a ballpark monthly committed price for option A vs option B so we can model TCO for our CFO.

I'll aim to confirm internal PO window by Monday. Tue/Wed times you suggested are fine — I'll tentatively take Tue 12/15 10:00 PT.

Best,
Evan
Head of Infrastructure | Calyx Systems
evan.liu@calyxsys.com

Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Finalize reserve matrix & evaluation agenda

Internal note before alignment call — looping in because there are a few gating items we should pre-answer so the call is productive:

- Lead time confirmation: operations confirms ~10 weeks for Dedicated pool procurement in us-west for H100 racks, assuming PO within 7 days of sizing confirmation. This includes rack ordering, network provisioning, and safety testing.
- SOC2 / security: CS will need SOC2 Type II evidence (we already have the package and can share the control matrix). Marissa: can you prep the SOC2 extract for Calyx?
- Risk mitigation: recommend a fallback model variant profile (quantized LLM) to reduce peak GPU need by ~30% during the first 90 days if we hit supply delays. That profile is documented in the attached reserve_matrix under "Fallback" tab.
- MAP cadence suggestion:
  1) Dec 15: alignment call — lock SKU and PO window
  2) Dec 16–23: finalize contract & procurement PR
  3) Jan 5–Jan 31: staging & acceptance
  4) Feb 1: prod cutover (if acceptance passes)

Related HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7842 (internal)

Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evan Liu <evan.liu@calyxsys.com>, procurement@calyxsys.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:48:00 +0000
Subject: RE: Finalize reserve matrix & evaluation agenda

Evan — thanks, all. Quick wrap and firm asks ahead of Tue's call.

Decisions / confirmations:
- GPU pool sizing: we will plan on the H100-equivalent path by default: 24 H100-equivalent units (interpreted as 6 H100 racks with expected overhead for redundancy). We also documented an A100 mapping in the sheet in case you'd prefer that SKU.
- Provisioning lead time: Redwood confirms 10 weeks from signed PO to Dedicated capacity availability in us-west (this includes staging window). We will provide a signed provisioning SLA clause in the contract addendum.
- Acceptance gates: SOC2 extract provided on request; staging access contingent on standard NDA + SOC2 evidence. Acceptance tests are the 3 canonical prompts + 48h traffic replay.
- Price estimates: Marissa will lead with a committed monthly rate for option A vs B in the procurement packet we'll send on Mon.

Action items:
- Calyx procurement: confirm PO window and preferred SKU by EOD Mon (2026-12-14).
- Marissa: attach SOC2 extract and committed pricing (Marissa will push both to this thread + HubSpot).
- Neha: prepare a succinct provisioning SLA paragraph we can insert in the MSA.

Meeting: Tue 2026-12-15 10:00 PT — 30 min. Calendar invite to follow.

Attachments referenced: reserve_matrix_v1.xlsx, MAP_agenda_v2.pdf, calyx_requirements.docx

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Ben Carter
